title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Drive, 100+ Combo, Car Skin Changer+
features:
farm a combo scoring mechanic by performing extremely close overtakes of traffic without crashing. It controls the car by applying physics forces directly to the seat assembly via a LinearVelocity and AlignOrientation rig, bypassing the locked throttle and steering upvalues inside the chassis script. The autopilot scans the road and nearby vehicles, plans candidate lines across the road, and selects the one that gets as close to traffic as possible without violating a configurable minimum safety gap; when the combo meter runs low, it actively hunts for the nearest car to keep the streak alive.
Physics-based Auto Drive – directly controls speed, steering, and altitude via seat constraints, optimizing for near-miss overtakes to maintain a combo while avoiding collisions.
Intelligent Traffic & Route Handling – scans road and traffic to plan safe overtake lines, can follow a recorded lap, and hunts for vehicles when the combo meter is low.
Garage Utilities – automatically spawns the best owned car and provides a client-side cosmetic skin changer that can make any car look like any other in the game.
